# pve_ha_disarm (Action)

Disarm the HA cluster for maintenance (stops HA services).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ha_disarm" "example" {
  config {
  resource_mode = "freeze"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ha_disarm.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_mode` (String) Controls how HA managed resources are handled while disarmed. The current state of resources is not affected. 'freeze': new commands and state changes are not applied. 'ignore': resources are removed from HA tracking and can be managed as if they were not HA managed. One of: `freeze`, `ignore`.
